scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) For Promoting Telecom & Networking Products Manufacturing In India
other_conditions: Must be a company manufacturing the specified telecom and networking products in India
Any foreign (non‑resident) investment must comply with the FDI Policy 2020

Global Manufacturing Revenue must exceed the defined thresholds: more than ₹10,000 Crore for global companies, more than ₹250 Crore for domestic companies, and more than ₹10 Crore for MSMEs (base year)
Must meet the minimum cumulative incremental investment and incremental sales thresholds as per Annexure 2 for each financial year
Applicant must not have applied for or received benefits under any other Central Government PLI scheme for the same product
Maximum financial allocation for the MSME category is limited to ₹1,000 Crore over the five‑year period
MSME status is determined at the time of selection and remains fixed for the duration of the scheme
Cumulative investment from 01‑04‑2021 onward is used to assess eligibility for incremental investment thresholds
benefits_summary: Provides cash incentives ranging from 4% to 7% of incremental investment based on investment thresholds, with an additional 1% incentive for design‑led manufacturing.
documents_required: Proof of deposit of application fee
